datasets.name: FFHQ
datasets.prompt: a photo of a closed face
datasets.provenance: Existing 00000.png–00999.png. Authors did not release exact subset IDs; verify equivalence before claiming a numerical match.

datasets.name: DIV2K
datasets.provenance: Existing 0001.png–0800.png; DAPE captions must be joined by filename, not line order.

datasets.name: AFHQ
datasets.provenance: Original StarGAN-v2 AFHQ validation cats and dogs, 500 per class. This 1000-image composition is inferred from the paper's dog/cat prompts; authors did not release subset IDs.

operator_policy: one deterministic operator per dataset/task, shared by all methods
randomness_policy: stable per-image corruption seed for pairing and restart; differs from upstream sequential RNG stream
gpu_selection: Inherited single CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES from monitor; no fixed physical device
